Owner.description: Object owner management permissions have been granted for replication to the destination bucket, allowing the destination bucket to read objects and grant other accounts permission to read objects

Bucket.description: Name of the bucket storing object replicas identified by the rule

StorageClass.description: Specify the storage class for objects replicated to the target bucket. Options: STANDARD: Standard storage. STANDARD_IA: Infrequent access storage. GLACIER_IR: Archive instant retrieval storage. INTELLIGENT_TIERING: Intelligent tiering storage. ARCHIVE: Archive storage. COLD_ARCHIVE: Cold archive storage. DEEP_COLD_ARCHIVE: Deep cold archive storage

StorageClassInheritDirective.description: Set the storage class for objects replicated to the target bucket. Options: SOURCE_OBJECT: Inherit the storage class of the source bucket object. DESTINATION_BUCKET: Inherit the default storage class of the target bucket

HistoricalObject.description: Show the percentage of historical data that has been replicated

NewObject.description: Show the timestamp when data is replicated to the target bucket

HistoricalObjectReplication.description: Enable historical object replication. If enabled, historical objects matching this rule will be replicated. Options: Enabled: Enable historical object replication. Disabled: Do not enable historical object replication

ID.description: Unique identifier for the rule, less than 255 characters

PrefixSet.description: Object name prefix to which this rule applies

Status.description: Specify whether to enable this rule. Options: Enabled: Enable this rule. Disabled: Do not enable this rule

description: Manage cross-region replication configuration for the specified TOS bucket. This resource uses the bucket as the primary key. Create and Update will write the replication role and rule set as a whole. Delete will remove the replication configuration from the bucket

Bucket.description: Name of the bucket to configure for cross-region replication

Role.description: Role name. The role must have read and write permissions for TOS and service access permissions. You can also use the default TOS role
